desc:
This is joseki when there is a low white stone at <A:G18>, <B:H17>, or nearby.

In that case, Black gets some forcing moves in the corner while giving White extra thickness (White is already effectively alive).

There are also instances where black can use this joseki if the wall is pincered by a stone at around <C:Q12>. The idea is to have the option for eyespace in the corner and to counterattack, see [AI Joseki #1 The Direct 3-3 Invasion variation 1](https://youtu.be/JLUyBCZIGKQ?t=816).
